cn.description:
AlpinePRO is an advanced outdoor navigation, terrain analysis, route planning, and team coordination application designed for hiking, exploration, field operations, search activities, and professional outdoor use.

Navigate with detailed 2D maps, interactive 3D terrain, precise coordinate tools, offline map support, targets, routes, tracks, and real-time team features.

2D AND 3D MAPS

• Explore detailed 2D maps and realistic 3D terrain  
• View elevation and analyze mountains, valleys, and surrounding landforms  
• Use satellite, hybrid, topographic, relief, trail, tactical, and other supported layers  
• Display MGRS grid lines with real 1 × 1 km squares  
• Preserve the selected map position between screens and fullscreen mode  

OFFLINE MAPS

• Automatically cache viewed map areas  
• Download supported 3D regions for offline use  
• Select 5 km, 10 km, 25 km, or 50 km download areas  
• Monitor download progress and storage usage  
• Import supported offline maps, including MBTiles  

COORDINATE TOOLS

• View MGRS, UTM, latitude/longitude, DMS, DDM, and other formats  
• Search by entering coordinates  
• Copy, share, and convert coordinates  
• Select exact positions using the map-center marker  

TARGETS, ROUTES, AND TRACKS

• Create named targets and map markers  
• Add numbered route points from the map center  
• Organize targets and route points into groups  
• Build routes by connecting multiple points  
• Add names and notes to route points  
• Record GPS tracks and review distance, duration, speed, elevation, and points  
• Export supported geographic data formats  

NAVIGATION AND COMPASS

• Navigate to targets, route points, and team members  
• View heading, bearing, distance, speed, and estimated arrival time  
• Use integrated compass and map navigation modes  
• Receive configurable destination-distance alerts  
• Access augmented reality navigation on supported devices  

TEAM ROOM

• Create a private team or join using a session code  
• Share your live location when you choose  
• View participating members on the map with individual colors and names  
• View shared battery status and location information  
• Send messages, images, and supported field packages  
• Assign roles and manage members as the team owner  
• Temporarily mute team notifications  

TEAM NOTIFICATIONS

Send notifications to members of the active team:

• Emergency Help  
• Attention  
• Order  
• Under Attack  
• Custom Notification  

Location sharing and team communication require the appropriate permissions and an internet connection.

FIELD PACKAGES

• Create and share AlpinePRO field packages  
• Store targets, routes, route points, notes, and supported content in an .aqpmap file  
• Preview package contents before importing  
• Merge imported information with existing data  
• Share prepared field information with other AlpinePRO users  

ADDITIONAL TOOLS

• GPS photo geotagging  
• Distance and area calculations  
• Sun and moon information  
• Elevation and terrain information  
• Measurement, drawing, and marked-area tools  
• Light, dark, and tactical themes  
• Multiple language support  

PRIVACY

Live location sharing remains disabled until the user enables it and can be stopped at any time. Team information is available only within the active team according to its access controls.

IMPORTANT NOTICE

AlpinePRO is a navigation and planning aid. GPS, compass, map, elevation, weather, coordinate, and arrival-time information may be affected by device sensors, environmental conditions, third-party data, or network availability. Verify critical information using official sources and appropriate professional equipment.

AlpinePRO does not replace official emergency services. Contact the appropriate local emergency authority in an emergency whenever possible.

• Receive configurable destination-distance alerts

TEAM ROOM

• Create a private team or join using a session code

• View participating members on the map with individual colors and names  
• View shared battery status and location information  
• Send messages, images, and supported field packages

AlpinePRO is an advanced outdoor navigation, terrain analysis, route planning, and team coordination application designed for hiking, exploration, field operations, search activities, and professional outdoor use.

Navigate with detailed 2D maps, interactive 3D terrain, precise coordinate tools, offline map support, targets, routes, tracks, and real-time team features.

2D AND 3D MAPS

• Explore detailed 2D maps and realistic 3D terrain  
• View elevation and analyze mountains, valleys, and surrounding landforms  
• Use satellite, hybrid, topographic, relief, trail, tactical, and other supported layers  
• Display MGRS grid lines with real 1 × 1 km squares  
• Preserve the selected map position between screens and fullscreen mode  

OFFLINE MAPS

• Automatically cache viewed map areas  
• Download supported 3D regions for offline use  
• Select 5 km, 10 km, 25 km, or 50 km download areas  
• Monitor download progress and storage usage  
• Import supported offline maps, including MBTiles  

COORDINATE TOOLS

• View MGRS, UTM, latitude/longitude, DMS, DDM, and other formats  
• Search by entering coordinates  
• Copy, share, and convert coordinates  
• Select exact positions using the map-center marker  

TARGETS, ROUTES, AND TRACKS

• Create named targets and map markers  
• Add numbered route points from the map center  
• Organize targets and route points into groups  
• Build routes by connecting multiple points  
• Add names and notes to route points  
• Record GPS tracks and review distance, duration, speed, elevation, and points  
• Export supported geographic data formats  

NAVIGATION AND COMPASS

• Navigate to targets, route points, and team members  
• View heading, bearing, distance, speed, and estimated arrival time  
• Use integrated compass and map navigation modes  
• Receive configurable destination-distance alerts  
• Access augmented reality navigation on supported devices  

TEAM ROOM

• Create a private team or join using a session code  
• Share your live location when you choose  
• View participating members on the map with individual colors and names  
• View shared battery status and location information  
• Send messages, images, and supported field packages  
• Assign roles and manage members as the team owner  
• Temporarily mute team notifications  

TEAM NOTIFICATIONS

Send notifications to members of the active team:

• Emergency Help  
• Attention  
• Order  
• Under Attack  
• Custom Notification  

Location sharing and team communication require the appropriate permissions and an internet connection.

FIELD PACKAGES

• Create and share AlpinePRO field packages  
• Store targets, routes, route points, notes, and supported content in an .aqpmap file  
• Preview package contents before importing  
• Merge imported information with existing data  
• Share prepared field information with other AlpinePRO users  

ADDITIONAL TOOLS

• GPS photo geotagging  
• Distance and area calculations  
• Sun and moon information  
• Elevation and terrain information  
• Measurement, drawing, and marked-area tools  
• Light, dark, and tactical themes  
• Multiple language support  

PRIVACY

Live location sharing remains disabled until the user enables it and can be stopped at any time. Team information is available only within the active team according to its access controls.

IMPORTANT NOTICE

AlpinePRO is a navigation and planning aid. GPS, compass, map, elevation, weather, coordinate, and arrival-time information may be affected by device sensors, environmental conditions, third-party data, or network availability. Verify critical information using official sources and appropriate professional equipment.

AlpinePRO does not replace official emergency services. Contact the appropriate local emergency authority in an emergency whenever possible.

tw.description:
AlpinePRO is an advanced outdoor navigation, terrain analysis, route planning, and team coordination application designed for hiking, exploration, field operations, search activities, and professional outdoor use.

Navigate with detailed 2D maps, interactive 3D terrain, precise coordinate tools, offline map support, targets, routes, tracks, and real-time team features.

2D AND 3D MAPS

• Explore detailed 2D maps and realistic 3D terrain  
• View elevation and analyze mountains, valleys, and surrounding landforms  
• Use satellite, hybrid, topographic, relief, trail, tactical, and other supported layers  
• Display MGRS grid lines with real 1 × 1 km squares  
• Preserve the selected map position between screens and fullscreen mode  

OFFLINE MAPS

• Automatically cache viewed map areas  
• Download supported 3D regions for offline use  
• Select 5 km, 10 km, 25 km, or 50 km download areas  
• Monitor download progress and storage usage  
• Import supported offline maps, including MBTiles  

COORDINATE TOOLS

• View MGRS, UTM, latitude/longitude, DMS, DDM, and other formats  
• Search by entering coordinates  
• Copy, share, and convert coordinates  
• Select exact positions using the map-center marker  

TARGETS, ROUTES, AND TRACKS

• Create named targets and map markers  
• Add numbered route points from the map center  
• Organize targets and route points into groups  
• Build routes by connecting multiple points  
• Add names and notes to route points  
• Record GPS tracks and review distance, duration, speed, elevation, and points  
• Export supported geographic data formats  

NAVIGATION AND COMPASS

• Navigate to targets, route points, and team members  
• View heading, bearing, distance, speed, and estimated arrival time  
• Use integrated compass and map navigation modes  
• Receive configurable destination-distance alerts  
• Access augmented reality navigation on supported devices  

TEAM ROOM

• Create a private team or join using a session code  
• Share your live location when you choose  
• View participating members on the map with individual colors and names  
• View shared battery status and location information  
• Send messages, images, and supported field packages  
• Assign roles and manage members as the team owner  
• Temporarily mute team notifications  

TEAM NOTIFICATIONS

Send notifications to members of the active team:

• Emergency Help  
• Attention  
• Order  
• Under Attack  
• Custom Notification  

Location sharing and team communication require the appropriate permissions and an internet connection.

FIELD PACKAGES

• Create and share AlpinePRO field packages  
• Store targets, routes, route points, notes, and supported content in an .aqpmap file  
• Preview package contents before importing  
• Merge imported information with existing data  
• Share prepared field information with other AlpinePRO users  

ADDITIONAL TOOLS

• GPS photo geotagging  
• Distance and area calculations  
• Sun and moon information  
• Elevation and terrain information  
• Measurement, drawing, and marked-area tools  
• Light, dark, and tactical themes  
• Multiple language support  

PRIVACY

Live location sharing remains disabled until the user enables it and can be stopped at any time. Team information is available only within the active team according to its access controls.

IMPORTANT NOTICE

AlpinePRO is a navigation and planning aid. GPS, compass, map, elevation, weather, coordinate, and arrival-time information may be affected by device sensors, environmental conditions, third-party data, or network availability. Verify critical information using official sources and appropriate professional equipment.

AlpinePRO does not replace official emergency services. Contact the appropriate local emergency authority in an emergency whenever possible.
